state: PROPOSED — authored by the G0-C spike (2026-09-03, D-036); D-034 ruled by D-037 (2026-09-03: transition → claim is STATE_TRANSITION_OF, SUPERSEDES frozen to comparable kinds); identities minted under it stay PROVISIONAL until WRL-P0 seals the profile (GAP-W11)
shape: WRL §D6.1 eight items plus role declarations (the spec-text hole R5 found, GAP-W1); enforced by G0's own validator (lib/wrl_world.mjs) until WRL can load a profile (D-017)

roles.note: one role per spec §3.1 node kind; SOURCE_LOCATION is an object so LOCATED_IN has a terminal; one nominal port `node` per object (GAP-W7 adapter); static_config carries the lid and the observed attrs

object_id_encoding.rule: the kernel requires object_id to match ^\w+$ (GAP-W12); a lid is encoded reversibly: `_` becomes `__`; every other character outside [A-Za-z0-9] becomes `_` followed by two uppercase hex digits per UTF-8 byte; decoding reads `__` as `_` and `_HH` as a byte. The raw lid is also kept in static_config.lid.

enumerations.note: each registry's evidence vocabulary is its own enumeration and is never merged (Q-10); the values are the registry's own tokens carried on evidence_state.token with evidence_state.vocabulary naming the registry

relation_signatures.attributes: the relation record's proposition-level attrs (D-029): relation_field on the six relation-field kinds; from_text/to_text (token-history steps) and typed (typed promotions) on STATE_TRANSITION_OF (D-037; they rode on SUPERSEDES before the ruling); otherwise {}. Occurrence data (assertions) never enters a revision (WRL D8.3).

endpoint_constraints.note: D-037 PAIRS form: each kind lists its allowed [source kind, target kind] pairs explicitly (the former [srcKinds, tgtKinds] product is expanded); `*` = any object kind. Spec §3.2 from → to, widened only where both pins show a real triple (REPRESENTS → LAW: E-46a is a representation record in the CROSS category). SUPERSEDES is frozen as a REPLACEMENT between semantically comparable entities (claim→claim, round→round, transition→transition) stated by a source, never inferred from temporal order; transition → claim is STATE_TRANSITION_OF. The G0 validator (lib/wrl_world.mjs) refuses a relation whose endpoints are not a listed pair.

validators: every terminal names an object of the world
no float / undefined / NaN / non-ASCII in any hashed value (spec §6.2)
no key named x, y, position, layout, started_at, finished_at, host anywhere in the artifact

canonical_defaults.omitted_attributes: omitted, never defaulted to a value

world_identity.rule: sha256 over WRL serializeArtifact(canonical artifact); objects sorted identity-first (object_id, role); relations sorted by serializeArtifact(identity_seed); duplicate seeds refused; NEVER `sem-` (D-009, D-017); a later real WRL seal is a supersession with recorded equivalence, not a rename

relation_identity.rev: WRL kernel relationRevisionId over the canonical revision (kernel-minted)
relation_identity.provisional_allocation_preimage_id: G0-computed, prefix `grelpre-` (GAP-W11 relabel, D-037: a value the kernel cannot mint is not presented as a `rel-`): sha256 over serializeArtifact({tag: WRL_RELATION, variant: named-initial, world_id: <gsem->, relation_name: <statement lid>}) — the D8.1 preimage with the gsem- as world scope, because the kernel's validateAllocation refuses any world_id that is not `sem-`. The hex is what the kernel WOULD mint for this preimage; only the prefix differs. Labelled adapter; not kernel-minted; not a WRL rel-. World-scoped by D8.5: every grelpre- moves when the gsem- moves; the stable cross-world name is the statement lid.
